name: Strict Safety
principle: Single-scenario safety first. Any regression versus LOCAL is a deployment defect.
rationale: Zero degrade rate and worst-case ΔR; strict non-inferiority; 1 extra independent batch. Not fit from 3/64 or -0.214.

name: Balanced Deployment
principle: Allow only rare, bounded losses; require non-negative average gain and one extra unseen batch.
rationale: 1-in-100 rare-event cap; worst-case at most 0.10 of R in [0,1]; aggregate non-inferiority; 1 extra batch. Not 5% or -0.25.

name: Conservative-with-Fallback
principle: Use LOCAL fallback as a risk control; allow limited degradation if average gain, bounded loss, and repeated unseen batches all hold.
rationale: 2-in-100 cap; worst-case at most 1/8 of R; min mean ΔR 0.02 of R; 2 extra independent batches. Not padded from observed 64.
